rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for smoking tobacco, including cigarettes, cigars, and pipes.
Use 煙 as the all-purpose word for visible smoke; in slang or drug-related contexts it can also mean something to smoke.

example.english: The whole room is full of smoke.
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 seng4 gaan1 dou1 hai6 jin1

rows.note: Use 煙仔 when you specifically mean a cigarette rather than smoke in general.

example.jyutping: sik6 zi1 jin1 zai2 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for preserving or preparing food by treating it with smoke.

example.english: The chef uses firewood to smoke sausages.
example.jyutping: si1 fu6 jung6 muk6 caai4 fan1 laap6 coeng2
